summary:
HORIZON 404 is an interactive space archaeology application that explores abandoned NASA spacecraft, scientific equipment, and historical artifacts left behind on the Moon and Mars. Its main purpose is to preserve the history and achievements of space exploration through storytelling, interactive maps, 3D models, and augmented reality (AR).
The application features important space exploration artifacts, including the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle, Opportunity Rover, Ingenuity Helicopter, and InSight Lander. Users can explore their historical backgrounds, missions, technical details, and reasons for being left behind.
The app includes an interactive planetary map that displays historical landing sites and space relics across the Moon and Mars. Its AR feature allows users to view realistic 3D representations of spacecraft and equipment using their device's camera and sensors. Users can also explore detailed stories, bookmark interesting artifacts, and track their exploration progress.
details:
HORIZON 404 – Abandoned but Not Forgotten is an Android-based application designed to preserve and showcase the history of humanity's space exploration missions. It focuses on abandoned spacecraft, landers, rovers and scientific equipment left on the Moon and Mars.

The application allows users to explore planetary locations through interactive maps, discover space artifacts, read their mission histories, and understand their scientific importance. It also includes features such as bookmarks, exploration progress tracking, 3D visualization and augmented reality (AR) concepts to create an engaging learning experience.

The main benefit of this project is making space exploration history accessible, interactive and educational. Its intended impact is to inspire students and space enthusiasts, encourage scientific curiosity, and preserve the legacy of important space missions for future generations.

The project is developed as an Android mobile application. The APK contains Jetpack Compose-style user interface components and screen-based navigation. The exact programming language and development tools used are not confirmed. The project focuses on mobile software, interactive interfaces and digital visualization.

The creative aspect of HORIZON 404 is its unique idea of treating abandoned space equipment not as forgotten objects but as valuable pieces of human history. We considered user experience, educational value, accessibility, scientific accuracy, visual presentation and future scalability while developing the concept.

Our vision is to turn forgotten space exploration artifacts into stories that everyone can discover, explore and appreciate.
